draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Willy Guggenheim (offlane→jungle).

coaching.headline: Eleven won fights to their five and not one of us was ever caught out alone — the brawls were chaos but the discipline held, 73,095 objective damage to 17,112.
coaching.team: Four shaky lane reads turned this into a 32-minute brawl, and the team won it on two numbers: eleven fight wins to five, and zero solo deaths on our side while we caught them three times. The scare was real — the 25.3 fight at our Orb Prime went 0-5 with everyone present, covered only because Orb Prime was already banked in that window — and the response was the answer film: 4-0 at 26.5, 5-1 at our Primal Fangtooth at 28.6, 5-0 at 31.2 to close. Riktor's pull-silence-suppress chain wanted us clumped; the late fights stayed spaced and he got nothing.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: After the 0-5 scare at our Orb Prime at 25.3, the team ripped off 4-0, 5-1 and 5-0 in three straight fights from 26.5 to 31.2 — fourteen kills against one death to end the game.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Sparrow carried the endgame — 14 kills with Steel dead to him six times, 37858 hero damage, and the 31.2 fight where he and Gadget went 5-0 into all five of them. Eight deaths was the mid-game tax; the discipline after minute 26 is the part worth repeating.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's Grux put up 44885 mitigated, 18061 objective damage and 13 assists. The early flags are the note: ahead and absent at 3.9, never joining at 8.6 and 12.4, while those fights went 0-2 and 1-3; the late-game Grux who showed up to every brawl is why the game flipped.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Feng Mao was everywhere — 9/6/14 with a team-high 30571 objective damage, plus the 23.2 fight taken one-against-three and won 2-1. Two wards is the drill; his 18.9 fall was the only death all game the file priced at an objective, their 19-minute Mini Prime.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Our damage is 4/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
ourKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
ourKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
ourKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
ourKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

cc.note: They brought 11 hard-CC abilities to our 7. Fight after Steel's Shield Slam and Riktor's Skewer and Khaimera's Cull are used, spread out instead of grouping in a line, and the front line can buy tenacity.

kit: Hard CC: Riplash (pull), Shock Therapy (silence), Skewer (suppress).
threat.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.
answers: Magical armor on whoever it kept killing.
Tenacity on the players it caught.

fedBy: Tainted Scepter (Malice): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice.• Stacks up to 15 times.• Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly.• Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 861 hero damage a minute, more than 76% of Riktor carry players this patch (28% of the team's). The damage came from Tainted Scepter, Claw Of Hermes, Fire Blossom.
Skewer at rank 3: 85s base, about 63.9s by the end (25% shorter) from 33 ability haste: Tainted Scepter 10, Magnify 15, Typhoon 8.
16 takedowns (8 kills, 8 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Riktor dealt 27,557 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +250 magical power from items.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.

Claw Of Hermes (item): On Successful Basic Attack: Against Melee Heroes: Drain 2.5% of their Max Mana. Against Ranged Heroes: Drain 4% of their Max Mana. Deals True Damage equal to 75% of the Mana Drained.
Claw Of Hermes (item): Based on the Target's Missing Mana: Abilities deal 0-12% more Damage.
Fire Blossom (item): Burn nearby Enemy Units: Deals 15 (+1%) Damage each second.Firestorm - When Heatwave damages a Target: Deals 5% more damage each second, up to 40%.
Zap O' 9-Chains (augment): On Ability Cast, Riktor’s next Basic Attack within 3s zaps 9 nearby Enemies, dealing 15 (+5 per Level)(+25% )(+30%) Damage.
Toughness: +1150 health, +50 physical armor; took 48,834 damage, mitigated 42,189, died 8 times.

Mirage: When at 4 stacks of Cyclone: Dash a short distance. Mirages:)
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Claw Of Hermes, Typhoon, Zap O' 9-Chains.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Riktor killed built magical armor (Grux). We killed Riktor 8 times.
Copy it? Too few Riktor carry games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

card.lesson: Skewer came back about every 64s instead of 85s by the end (25% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
